page.layout: One printed page, chronological table in columns: left column "Anni mundi" year numbers; central column "MACEDONVM" with entries and page references at right; a further partial column at the right edge, cut off; below the table a short paragraph spanning the columns. Running head at top centre.; Two printed pages? No: one page of text in parallel columns. Left edge: a fragment of a narrow column of dates and numbers (cut off at the left, partly visible). Centre-right: a three-column table of chronology (Latin and Roman kings, with page references), with side numbers in the margin at the right; below the table, a full-width paragraph of text in two lines and a signature line "R E." at the right.

main_text.l: um CCLIX. ß Eusebii λογισμὸς corgio

page.notes: Right-hand column is cut off by the scan edge and is not transcribed. Several entries are faint; readings marked as given are uncertain in places. The printed text "Omnes anni regni Medor..." continues into the cut area; "Medorum" and "Graecis" are read from partial letters. Left margin shows show-through and stains only. Right-margin numbers (23, 44, 38, 41, 32, 23, 37) belong to the table column; left-margin dates (381, 404, 446, 484, 527, 557, 380) are fragments of a cut column. Some table entries are read with [?] uncertainty; the table is printed as a three-column chronology with cells separated by lines.
